SUBJECT:	Virginia Slims Ultra Lights & Capri Market Checks	

|

On July 22, I conducted a market check on V.Slims Ultra and Capri in Shreveport, Louisiana, and on the following day, a separate market check on Capri in Tampa, Florida. Both market checks covered a cross-section of trade classes and ethnic areas.

SHREVEPORT, LOUISIANA - JULY 22.

Accompanied by DM Rick Hufford, 19 stores and Harrison Co. (Shreveport's largest tobacco distributor representing 24% of this market) were visited.

Sales

• V.Slims Ultra

- Approximately two months at retail, movement for V.Slims Ultra appears good, with the 5-for-3 and lighter promotions currently in six stores.

- Estimates obtained from 13 stores place V.Slims Ultra at a 1.4 share. Harrison Co. shows this brand at a 1.0 for the period 6/1 to 6/26.

Capri

- About seven months at retail, movement for Capri has reportedly slowed significantly since its free carton/pack and B1G1F promotions, with a few B1G1F packs remaining (from its second run some time during July) in six of the stores called on.

- Based on estimates collected from the stores, Capri averages a 1.4 share. Interestingly, retailers perceive the brand's performance to be similar to that of V.Slims Ultra, fair to poor. Harrison reports Capri at a 0.7 share for the period 6/1 - 6/26, with $1.50 on-carton coupons during w/e 6/26.
